body:
# Sulfur tags
rename you bucket of sulfur cube to a specific name and get some interesting effects
# Names
- big
- small
- balloon: make the mob fly when leashed with a lead
- small balloon
- big balloon
- invisible: make the mob invisible when it absorbs a block
- small invisible
- big invisible
